additional_limitations: Eligibility for Medi-Cal may occur retroactively and it may take time for eligibility determinations to be processed and reported to DHCS. As such, eligibility data is approximately 96% complete for the current month, 98% complete within one month, and over 99% complete within 2 months. Data is considered preliminary and subject to change for one year.
citation: State of California, Department of Health Care Services, Medi-Cal Certified Eligibles, by County and Dual Status
de_identification_method: Public Aggregate Reporting for DHCS Business Reports at http://www.dhcs.ca.gov/dataandstats/Pages/PublicReportingGuidelines.aspx
description:
These files contain monthly data by county for Medi-Cal certified eligibles, by various demographics traits. The data is split out and not distributed as a single dataset for the purposes of de-identification.

The dataset by Aid Category provides monthly reporting from January 2022 through the most recent month available. Recent updates now reflect eligibility reporting pertaining to the full-scope expansion of the Adult Medi-Cal population, regardless of their immigration status.

An archived version of the dataset by Aid Category covering January 2010 through August 2024 has been reuploaded for historical reference.

__Note: Caution should be exercised when referencing immigration status data for calendar year 2022. The reliability of the 2022 data has not been fully verified as the data element was integrated into the DHCS MIS/DSS beginning in January 2023.__

resources.description: The Reference table maintained by DHCS, displays aid code categories by aid code. Aid codes identify the criteria by which each person qualifies for Medi-Cal and the types of services he or she receives and make clear whether the services are funded by the State or Federal government or both. An aid code is a combination of two numbers or a letter and a number and is attached to a Medi-Cal beneficiary's identification numbers. Aid code category refers to a unique grouping of distinct aid codes into broad categories such as CHIP, Seniors and Persons with Disabilities, and Long-Term Care. For a description of each aid code, see [Medi-Cal Aid Code Master Chart](https://www.dhcs.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/2026-Master-Aid-Code-Chart.pdf).
